recipe.visualDefinition: A group portrait of five individuals in winter attire, set against a textured teal background filled with stylized white snowflakes and falling snow particles. The composition is framed by a heavy vignette and features a two-tiered typographic header separated by a thin horizontal line with a central star motif.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject group centered against a flat, textured backdrop
Contrast between warm skin tones and cool teal/blue environment
Layering of white snowflakes both behind and in front of the subjects
Formal sans-serif title paired with an elegant, flowing script subtitle
coreInvariants: Teal-to-blue color palette for the background
Distressed, grunge-like texture on the edges
White snowflake illustrations of varying sizes and opacity

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five subjects arranged in a slightly staggered horizontal line, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central female figure in a white faux-fur coat acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the bold top title, down through the script subtitle, to the central figure, and then outward to the surrounding group members.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space at the top for typography, with textured margins on the left and right.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Teal and muted blue background providing a cool, wintry atmosphere.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White for snowflakes, typography, and the central coat to create high legibility and pop.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright cobalt blue coat on one subject to break the neutral clothing tones.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white elements and the dark teal background; skin tones are naturally saturated against the cool environment.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of a geometric sans-serif and a formal copperplate-style script.
letterConstructionRules: Upper-case sans-serif for the primary title with uniform stroke weight.
Title-case script for the subtitle with high stroke contrast and decorative swashes.
Horizontal rule with a central eight-pointed star separating the two lines.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended swash on the 'T' and 'M' in the script line to frame the text.

composition.relationshipToImage: placed in negative space above subjects

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Modern geometric sans-serif paired with a traditional, elegant script for a 'modern classic' holiday feel.

avoid: Serif fonts for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the clean, modern, high-impact look for the primary title.
Offers the necessary elegance and swashed terminals for the holiday subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A group portrait of five diverse people in winter coats and sweaters, smiling, standing in front of a textured teal background with white snowflake patterns and falling snow particles. Leave the top 25% of the image as clear teal space for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a bold white uppercase sans-serif title at the top center. Below it, add a thin white horizontal line with a small star in the middle. Under the line, add a white elegant script subtitle.

verificationChecks: Are the snowflakes layered both behind and in front of the people?
Is the teal background textured with a vintage/grunge vignette?
Is the contrast between the two font styles clear?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individuals
Exact snowflake geometry to avoid repetition
postGenerationChecks: Check for typographic legibility against the background.
Ensure the 'snow' effect doesn't obscure the subjects' faces.
Verify the vignette effect frames the subjects effectively.
Confirm the horizontal divider line is centered.
recipe.reuseFormula: Group Portrait + Textured Teal Backdrop + Layered Snowflakes + Dual-Font Centered Header (Sans-Serif/Script Mix).
